primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 本文はAchaiaと明記。Asiaではなく、別地域名である。

geographicAssessmentJa: ROM16:5の固定本文はfirst fruits of Achaia。Asiaへの結び付けは本文に反し、Achaiaとの混同も許容できない。Actsで同じIDに候補点があるが、このRomans用例に対する地図候補としては不適合。
sourceReuseJa: 既存地図座標はこのID/用例では継承せず、プロフィール座標を設定しない。

adjacentContextChecks.previousText: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
adjacentContextChecks.text: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
adjacentContextChecks.nextText: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
